subtitle: Verdicts for your fish tank
promotionalText: Log a water test and Tankmate tells you what to do about it — same day, next water change, or nothing at all. Works with no signal, no account and no cloud.
description:
Tankmate reads your water tests the way an experienced fishkeeper would. You enter what your kit shows; it tells you what to DO — not just stores a number on a chart.

WHAT IT ACTUALLY TELLS YOU
• Ammonia or nitrite above zero → the size and urgency of the water change
• KH dropping under 5 dKH → the warning before a pH crash, not after it
• Nitrate climbing → how fast, in ppm per week, and whether that rate is a problem
• Temperature and pH read in context, because stability beats chasing an ideal number

THE RATE MATTERS MORE THAN THE READING
One nitrate number means very little. Tankmate works out how fast it is climbing between tests and says whether your maintenance is keeping up.

WHAT ELSE IS IN IT
• Feeding — a sinking-food rotation so you are not feeding the same thing every night
• Incident playbook — what to do first when something is wrong, before you go looking for advice
• Holiday handover — generates a friend-proof sheet for whoever is feeding your fish while you are away, with a pill-organiser map so they cannot overfeed

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Every test, note and reminder stays on your iPhone
• No account, no sign-up, no cloud, no telemetry, no ads
• Nothing is ever uploaded: Tankmate itself makes no network requests (only Apple handles an optional Pro subscription)
• It works exactly the same with aeroplane mode on

NATIVE REMINDERS
Set a free weekly reminder to test the water. It is scheduled on your device — nothing is sent anywhere.

Built for freshwater tropical community tanks by someone who keeps one.

TANKMATE PRO (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
Everything above stays free. Tankmate Pro is for people with more than one tank:
• Multiple tanks — a separate log and verdicts for each, with a switcher
• Reminders per tank — water test, water change, feeding and filter clean on your schedule
• Parameter charts — every parameter over 30, 90 or 365 days with healthy-range bands, plus CSV export

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
• Tankmate Pro (yearly): auto-renewing subscription, billed once a year. The price for your region is shown in the app before you subscribe.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period.
• Manage or cancel any time in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions. You can restore a previous purchase from the Pro screen.
• Privacy Policy: https://tankmate.joanmarcriera.es/privacy/
• Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

_notes.privacyNutritionLabel: Data Not Collected — the app has no network access, so no data type can be transmitted. Matches Resources/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy. Purchases are processed by Apple (StoreKit); the app has no code that sends data anywhere. Re-check the nutrition label wording in ASC when adding the subscription.
_notes.reviewNotes: Tankmate is a local-first aquarium log. No account is needed and there is nothing to sign in to. All content is bundled in the app; it works with the device offline. The optional Pro subscription is explained in the Pro notes under subscription.
_notes.guideline42: Not a bare web wrapper: the app ships its content offline, has a native launch experience, and schedules local notification reminders that a website cannot. See apple/docs/APP-STORE-CONNECT.md.

subscription.price: Set in App Store Connect (Marc). Deliberately not in any copy.
subscription.guideline312: Description carries the auto-renew disclosure, privacy and terms links; the paywall shows localised price, period, Restore, Privacy and Terms.
subscription.termsOfUse: Apple standard EULA. The site has privacy/ and support/ pages only; add a custom terms/ page and set it as the custom EULA in ASC only if wanted.
subscription.reviewNotes: Pro is a yearly auto-renewing subscription (multi-tank, charts, per-tank reminders). Free features are unchanged. Restore Purchases is on the Pro screen (bell or chart icon, then Subscribe).
